# Dukan Yantra

> Dukan Yantra is a business management application for shopkeepers, with billing, inventory, product, customer and invoice capabilities.

The merchant portal supports barcode lookup and scanning, stock management, customer records, invoice generation and local marketplace synchronization.

## Product resources

- [Merchant portal](https://hardikkatare10-ux.github.io/billpilot/shopkeeper/dashboard): Sign in to access merchant billing and inventory tools.
- [Dukan Yantra catalog](/dukan-yantra/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable product catalog.
- [Project documentation](https://github.com/hardikkatare10-ux/billpilot): Source code and setup documentation.
